text: I'm a regular customer here, having come here for dental work many times. Every time, I make an appointment at 11 a.m. and I'm never late. Sometimes, I have to wait. But this time, I was 17 minutes late because of an accident that caused a traffic jam. When I arrived, I told my name at the counter. The staff said, "Customers with an appointment at 11 a.m. must be on time." Their tone and mannerisms were reassuring, but I didn't say anything. He continued talking incoherently because of the sound of a motorcycle approaching, so I asked him what he said. He smiled, showing his teeth and saying, "Go sit down," which I didn't like. I was going to get braces, but I didn't dare. The doctors here are actually lovely. I'll have to find a new place. A person's intentions are best known in their hearts.
